description: Extract an audio track from a video file into a standalone audio file. Supports the 'whisper_wav' preset (16kHz mono WAV) for speech recognition models, plus MP3, AAC, FLAC, and stream copy.

bitrate.description: Target audio bitrate for MP3 or AAC (e.g. '128k', '192k', '320k').

format.description: Audio format: 'whisper_wav' (16kHz mono WAV for Whisper), 'mp3', 'aac', 'flac', or 'copy' (extract without re-encoding). Default: 'mp3'.

inputPath.description: Path to the source video or audio file.

outputPath.description: Destination path for the output audio file (e.g. './extracted.wav' or './audio.mp3').

name: extract_audio
